## 3.2 Salarisschalen

# Personeelshandboek
## 3.2 Salarisschalen

De schalen worden jaarlijks geindexeerd op basis van de cao en de inflatie van het voorgaande jaar.

```
code blok dat heel moet blijven en nooit gesplitst mag worden door de chunker
```

trace.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kb_chunks ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, knowledge_base_id TEXT NOT NULL, document_id TEXT NOT NULL, chunk_id INT NOT NULL, lang TEXT, title TEXT, content TEXT NOT NULL, tsv TSVECTOR, embedding VECTOR(1024), source_uri TEXT, chunk_type TEXT DEFAULT 'content', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now() )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kb_chunks_tsv ON kb_chunks USING GIN (tsv)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kb_chunks_embedding ON kb_chunks USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 200)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kb_chunks_tenant_kb ON kb_chunks (tenant_id, knowledge_base_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kb_chunks_tenant_kb_doc ON kb_chunks (tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, document_id)
ALTER TABLE kb_chunks ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS chunk_type TEXT DEFAULT 'content'
ALTER TABLE kb_chunks ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS page_start INT
ALTER TABLE documents ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS original_content TEXT
SELECT a.atttypmod AS typmod FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'kb_chunks' AND a.attname = 'embedding' AND a.attnum > 0
BEGIN
DELETE FROM kb_chunks WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND knowledge_base_id = $2 AND document_id = $3
UPDATE documents SET original_content = $1 WHERE id = $2::uuid

## Salaris schalen
De tabel met schalen.
rows.title: Handboek

trace.sql: SET hnsw.ef_search = 100

SELECT id, title, content, source_uri, document_id, chunk_id, page_start, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS vec_score FROM kb_chunks WHERE knowledge_base_id = ANY($2::text[]) ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $3

SELECT id, title, content, source_uri, document_id, chunk_id, chunk_type, page_start, GREATEST( ts_rank_cd(tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('dutch', $1)) * 1.5, ts_rank_cd(tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1)) ) AS fts_score FROM kb_chunks WHERE knowledge_base_id = ANY($2::text[]) AND ( tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('dutch', $1) OR tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) ) ORDER BY fts_score DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT id::text FROM documents WHERE knowledge_base_id = ANY($1::uuid[])

SELECT id, title, content, source_uri, document_id, chunk_id, chunk_type, page_start, GREATEST( ts_rank_cd(tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('dutch', $1)) * 1.5, ts_rank_cd(tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1)) ) AS fts_score FROM kb_chunks WHERE knowledge_base_id = ANY($2::text[]) AND ( tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('dutch', $1) OR tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1) ) ORDER BY fts_score DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.id) c.id, c.title, c.content, c.source_uri, c.document_id, c.chunk_id FROM kb_chunks c INNER JOIN ( SELECT document_id, chunk_id FROM kb_chunks WHERE id = ANY($1::bigint[]) ) h ON c.document_id = h.document_id AND c.chunk_id BETWEEN h.chunk_id - 1 AND h.chunk_id + 1 WHERE c.id != ALL($1::bigint[]) LIMIT 10
